_comment: Merge the hooks block below into ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope) or
.claude/settings.json (project scope). Replace REPO_ROOT with the absolute
path to this repository -- install.sh prints the filled-in version for you.
This is the only component that makes RTL review unskippable. Without it the
skills still work, but the model may choose not to invoke them.
PostToolUse is the right event: the file is already written, and exit code 2
feeds the review back to the model as a blocking error it must act on. That
IS the auto-fix loop. rtl_gate.sh bounds it at 3 rounds.
Verify the matcher syntax against the current Claude Code hooks docs before
relying on it -- hook schemas evolve. The gate itself does not depend on a
specific JSON field: it also accepts a path as $1.
